title: How Justin Ernest invested nearly $500M into hot startups without a traditional VC fund
brief: Justin Ernest of Sabertooth VC deployed nearly $500M into high-profile startups including Anthropic, Anduril, and SpaceX by leveraging a captive LP network instead of raising a traditional venture fund. This alternative funding model bypassed the typical year-long fundraising cycle and demonstrates a new approach to deploying capital in the startup ecosystem.
